summary: Live staging failed for more than a month because both workers retained a terminal persistence-failed state after the database recovered. Restarting the game and its project router restored public staging health. The current release also has real provider CI failures and stale exact-runtime receipts; production admission remains independently gated.

items.title: Recover configured persistence after a transient database outage
items.why: The live workers remained persistence-failed for five weeks although PostgreSQL now accepts the same runtime credential. pool.ts had a one-shot initialization and nullified the pool on error with no retry; the game stayed HTTP 503 until a manual restart.
items.coreLoopStep: available certified match → durable result → trustworthy reward
items.recipe: Keep mutation admission fail-closed while configured persistence is unavailable, retry connections with bounded backoff and one active attempt, restore the exported pool only after SELECT 1, and simulate initial failure plus post-connect loss and recovery in a focused test. Then deploy and observe exact staging.

L1.recipe: Document the outage and restart instructions.

L2.recipe: Retry initial connection failure and verify return to healthy.

L3.recipe: Bound and coalesce retries for initial and idle-pool failure, preserve fail-closed writes, test both transitions, and observe live recovery.

items.title: Keep staging routing healthy when its game container restarts
items.why: After the game restarted and returned internal HTTP 200, the project router still returned 502. update.sh writes a static hostname in proxy_pass, which Nginx resolves only at startup or reload.
items.coreLoopStep: player opens stable staging → reaches a healthy certified match
items.recipe: Resolve the admitted container name through Docker DNS on each request with a bounded cache, validate the target name before config generation, run nginx -t through the existing deployment path, then restart the staged game container and verify the router and public health recover without a router restart.

L1.recipe: Add an operator instruction to restart the router after the app.

L2.recipe: Use Docker DNS dynamic resolution and validate generated Nginx syntax.

L3.recipe: Use dynamic resolution, reject unsafe target names, enforce it in deploy contracts, and prove a live app-only restart does not strand routing.

items.title: Restore project gates after protocol and dependency drift
items.why: The latest three main CI runs failed real formatting or test jobs. Today's 109-file propagated update broke the doctor import and scanned eight nonexistent Studio Ops roots. New unformatted paths fail the repository ratchet.
items.coreLoopStep: trusted source → verified build → safe player access
items.recipe: Quarantine the incompatible 109-file propagation batch, retain and repair the September protocol content, format every newly introduced path, fix the actual provider test failures without suppressions, and ship a signed Ark recurrence to the propagation owner. Require a green exact-SHA CI run before staging deployment.

L1.recipe: Repair the doctor import and scanner roots.

L2.recipe: Repair all current project contracts and formatting, run focused and aggregate verification, then send propagation feedback through Ark.

L3.recipe: Add recipient-specific propagation admission at the Studio Ops owner after Ark acceptance.

items.title: Deploy and observe the exact repaired revision on stable staging
items.why: The restored staging image is August's 7fbaedcd, while main has newer protocol and dependency commits. The incompatible local propagation batch was reverted. The old 27-cell visual, health, rollback, and promotion receipts cannot prove the new candidate.
items.coreLoopStep: safe public entry → current certified gameplay → observable release
items.recipe: After exact CI passes, dispatch staging dry-run and immutable live deploy for the pushed SHA; verify commit.txt, product smoke, signed 27-cell observation, theme/footer parity, rollback/restoration, and production admission. Promote only if all independent current gates are genuinely green.

L1.recipe: Verify public staging health and exact commit.

L2.recipe: Deploy exact main and collect current product smoke and signed observation.

L3.recipe: Complete exact deploy, visual/performance observation, promotion validation, rollback/restoration, and independent production admission.
